title: Junta Jet Drops Bomb Near School in Kan Phyu Village, Wetlet Township, Sagaing Region
detail: After midnight on August 7, 2026, a junta jet reportedly flying from Tada-U Air Base dropped a bomb near the Abhidhamma school in Kan Phyu village, Wetlet Township, Sagaing Region, damaging 2 school buildings and roughly 3 homes and killing 13 cattle. The strike was part of a broader pattern of drone and air attacks against villages in the Yoar Thar Yar tract.
